participation.context: Wrote the opening, struck two lines, and did not send the leaf.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Not in the room. The leaf is addressed to her and does not go.
participation.name: Anne Shakespeare

story.body: You wrote a short opening, struck the apology for the plays, and stopped before the leaf had an errand in it. It stays in the chamber. The year at the foot is 1594.

title: Struck the excuse in Anne's letter
